notes: 3-view quadruped reference sheet (communicator ticket M10/M11). Tortoise with basalt carapace, moss garden, leather skin, and blossom water lilies. creature.medium canvas (56x56, anchor 28,41).

fields.stance: standing on all four paws with its body horizontal, never sitting or standing upright
fields.description: a mossy wetland creature that shelters small plants upon its back
fields.anatomy: broad low-domed tortoise-like shell carved like basalt stone, four sturdy wrinkled legs with stubby toes, a blunt friendly head with dark round eyes, lush green moss growing across the carapace with small pink water lily blossoms blooming on top, short stubby tail
fields.colours: dark slate basalt shell, deep green moss patch, pale reed underbelly, warm leather skin, pink blossom flower petals
